name: Media Controls + Album Art
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Media controls for the Omarchy bar with live album art, now-playing details, and previous/play-pause/next buttons for Spotify and other players.

barWidget.description: Album art, now-playing details, and previous/play-pause/next controls.

schema.label: Maximum label width
schema.description: Maximum width of artist/title text in logical pixels.

schema.label: Show artist
schema.description: Show artist before the track title when metadata provides it.

schema.label: Transition duration
schema.description: Length of the track-change crossfade and the appear/disappear animation, in milliseconds. 0 turns all animation off.

schema.label: Track change grace
schema.description: How long to keep showing the current track while a player blanks its metadata between songs, in milliseconds. Measured against Spotify Web: ordinary skips leave the bus empty for under 200ms, but an ad boundary can run to nearly 3 seconds. 0 disables it.

schema.label: Track settle window
schema.description: How long a suspicious track must hold still before it reaches the bar, in milliseconds. Only applies to changes that look like another tab's media surfacing mid-skip: one that lost its next/previous controls, fell silent, or has been caught flashing past before. An ordinary track change is shown immediately and never waits. 0 disables the check.

schema.label: Label width behaviour
schema.description: smooth: the label resizes with each title. stable: it grows at once but only shrinks after the title settles, so skipping tracks stops shoving the rest of the bar. fixed: always reserve the maximum width and never reflow.
